F-T3-001.observed: The endpoint host check only recorded FAIL; the next statement probed policy.endpoint unconditionally, so a disallowed host such as example.invalid received an HTTP request.
F-T3-001.fix: checkEndpoint validates the host first and calls the probe only for an allowed local host; a disallowed or invalid endpoint reports FAIL with state NOT_PROBED_DISALLOWED_HOST and no network call.
F-T3-001.retest: tests/pkg-t3-omniroute-install-compat.test.ts 'never probes a disallowed or invalid endpoint': four disallowed/invalid endpoints (including a look-alike 127.0.0.1.example.invalid) produce zero probe calls; the allowed loopback host gets exactly one. Fails against the cycle-1 script.

F-T3-002.observed: satisfies short-circuited through some/every and dropped empty alternatives, so '>=24 || ^25', '<20 ^24' and '>=24 ||' could return true or false instead of UNKNOWN.
F-T3-002.fix: The whole range is validated first: every alternative must be non-empty and every token a supported comparator, and the version must be a full x.y.z; otherwise UNKNOWN. Only a fully valid range is evaluated.
F-T3-002.retest: tests/pkg-t3-omniroute-install-compat.test.ts 'reports partially unsupported or malformed engines ranges as UNKNOWN': eight malformed or partially unsupported ranges and a partial version return UNKNOWN; valid ranges still evaluate. Fails against the cycle-1 script.
